title: NTT Docomo customer data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by NTT Docomo, Jiji Press, Nippon.com, Nippon TV, ITmedia, Cybersecurity.com, Nikkei, CNET Japan, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Up to about 300,000 phone lines, per Docomo; two outlets report the briefing figure of 294,839 (204,157 personal).
who_is_affected: Docomo customers, personal and corporate, whose data was held by My docomo and the online shop, including some who had already cancelled.

known.text: Docomo says outside parties got into My docomo and the online shop.
Customer information leaked, for up to about 300,000 lines.
Names, birth dates, contact details, ID-document numbers and contract details leaked; for some, bank details.
My docomo is partly back as of Nov 22; the online shop and the iOS app are still in emergency maintenance.

not_known.text: Whether the leaked data has been misused or sold.
How much compensation will be paid, and to whom.
When the online shop and iOS app return.
